ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B3-2,
Community Shopping District and RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit
District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 4-J in the area bound by:

West 16" Street; South Central Park Avenue; the alley next south of and parallel to West
16" Street; the alley next west of and parallel to South Central Park Avenue; a line 385
feet south of and parallel to West 16" Street; and South Millard Avenue,

to those of a RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.

Common Address:
3615-3621 W. 16th Street
